course_description: This course improves your understanding of the various methods of research, some basic statistical designs and procedures, and the different parts of a thesis, including field and laboratory performance. The course output is an undergraduate thesis consisting of the defended proposal, results and discussions, and conclusion. This course includes the practical applications of Godly stewardship of nature through proper handling of different test organisms and research settings. It also includes character-building through proper experimentation and scientific paper oral presentation.

investigate and evaluate prominent literature connected to the research topic;
define the scope of the project, planning and scheduling the collaborative efforts of the team, and documenting the effort via oral and written proposals;
demonstrate that they can function, communicate, collaborate and continue to learn effectively as ethically and socially responsible CS professionals;

present to the assigned panelists the software for applications (Mobile apps, Game Creation, Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, Recommender Systems, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning and Machine Learning) with the necessary documentation.
